description: Winery-supported profiles of identifiable wines. Producer-specific details are distinguished from general sommelier suggestions; bottle artwork is inherited from the existing real-producer photo index and may represent another vintage.

bottles.vintageNote: Profile reflects the producer's 2022 anniversary bottling; the linked bottle photograph may show a different vintage.
bottles.intro: A rich Napa Cabernet made for people who enjoy concentrated fruit, rounded texture and oak that supports rather than dominates.
bottles.nose: Ripe dark fruit and gentle French-oak character.
bottles.palate: Rich, plush and rounded, with accessible, non-bitter tannins and enough acidity to keep the ripe fruit balanced.
bottles.finish: Lingering fruit, soft tannin and integrated oak.
bottles.pairingBasis: Sommelier pairing suggestions, not producer-certified recipes.
bottles.aeration: Consider 20–40 minutes of air for a young bottle; taste first.
bottles.sourceLabel: Caymus 2022 winemaker tasting notes

bottles.vintageNote: The notes are for the producer's 2023 bottling; bottle labels can change by vintage.
bottles.intro: A silky coastal Pinot Noir where juicy red fruit meets a gentle mocha edge and a lively finish.
bottles.nose: Red berries and mocha.
bottles.palate: Red cherry, blood orange, darker berry fruit and warming spice with fine tannins and balanced acidity.
bottles.finish: Long and lifted, with lingering spice and fruit.
bottles.pairingBasis: The first two pairings are suggested by La Crema; roast duck is an additional sommelier suggestion.
bottles.aeration: Serve slightly cool; usually little decanting needed.
bottles.sourceLabel: La Crema 2023 producer tasting and pairing notes

bottles.vintageNote: House notes describe the bottling across vintages, not one individually tasted year.
bottles.intro: A classic Barolo: aromatic roses and red fruit on the nose, followed by savory depth and firm but integrated structure.
bottles.nose: Plum, red and dark cherries, rose petals and tobacco.
bottles.palate: Rich and powerful with alpine herbs, red fruit and well-integrated tannins.
bottles.finish: Savory, leathery and persistent.
bottles.pairingBasis: Sommelier pairing suggestions based on Barolo's structure.
bottles.aeration: Young bottles often benefit from a decant; be gentler with mature vintages.
bottles.sourceLabel: Vietti Barolo winemaking and tasting profile

bottles.vintageNote: Winery notes reference the 2024 Carneros vintage; the product image may show another label year.
bottles.intro: A distinctive creamy, ripe Chardonnay balanced by a bright streak of acidity.
bottles.nose: Yellow peach, ripe melon and citrus.
bottles.palate: Ripe stone fruit and citrus framed by creamy vanilla and buttery nuances.
bottles.finish: Long and buttery, lifted by bright acidity.
bottles.pairingBasis: Winery food-pairing suggestions from the 2024 technical sheet.
bottles.aeration: Do not serve ice-cold: a few minutes out of the refrigerator helps its aromatics.
bottles.sourceLabel: Rombauer 2024 technical sheet

bottles.vintageNote: Tasting notes correspond to 2024; a current retail bottle image may display another vintage.
bottles.intro: An expressive Sauvignon Blanc that trades simple tropical sweetness for layered citrus, salinity and a crisp finish.
bottles.nose: Citrus, lime leaf, apricot and orange blossom.
bottles.palate: Passionfruit, grapefruit, white stone fruit and makrut lime with saline freshness.
bottles.finish: Long, concentrated and lemon-bright.
bottles.pairingBasis: Winery's 2024 pairing recommendation and general producer guidance.
bottles.aeration: Serve chilled and allow the glass to warm slightly as you taste.
bottles.sourceLabel: Cloudy Bay 2024 tasting notes

bottles.vintageNote: The house blend is non-vintage and is adjusted over releases.
bottles.intro: A polished, fresh Champagne with orchard fruit, citrus energy and a toasty accent.
bottles.nose: Green apple, citrus, mineral freshness, white flowers, brioche and nuts.
bottles.palate: Pear, white peach and apple, with fine bubbles and lively citrus.
bottles.finish: Bright and delicate with refreshing citrus lift.
bottles.pairingBasis: Producer's Brut Impérial food-pairing guidance.
bottles.aeration: Serve chilled in a tulip or white-wine glass; do not decant.
bottles.sourceLabel: Moët & Chandon Brut Impérial tasting and food-pairing guide

bottles.intro: A generous Washington Merlot, combining supple red fruit with the warmth of oak and baking spices.
bottles.nose: Ripe red berry and plum fruit with softly spiced oak.
bottles.palate: Expansive, smooth red fruit, with supple tannins from extended barrel maturation.
bottles.finish: A gently spiced finish with nutmeg and clove.
bottles.pairingBasis: Sommelier suggestions, selected for Merlot's red fruit and gentle oak character.
bottles.aeration: Taste on opening; 15–25 minutes of air can soften a young bottle.
bottles.sourceLabel: Chateau Ste. Michelle 2022 winery notes
bottles.vintageNote: Notes describe the 2022 Indian Wells Merlot (85% Merlot, 15% Syrah); pictured bottle year may vary.

bottles.intro: A warm-climate Australian Shiraz that is generous in fruit but structured enough to age.
bottles.nose: Baking spice, red and dark berry compote, blueberry pie and savory roasted-meat aromas.
bottles.palate: Blueberries, bilberries and poached plum meet cassia spice, smoky savory accents and velvety tannins.
bottles.finish: Long, layered and savory, with chocolate-textured tannins.
bottles.pairingBasis: Sommelier pairing suggestions for the producer's bold fruit and savory spice.
bottles.aeration: Young examples can open with 30–60 minutes of air.
bottles.sourceLabel: Penfolds Bin 28 Shiraz 2023 tasting notes
bottles.vintageNote: The tasting reference is 2023; bottle photographs may show another Bin 28 vintage.

bottles.intro: An oak-aged Rioja Reserva with lively red fruit, sweet spice and beautifully integrated tannins.
bottles.nose: Cherry, red currant and plum developing into licorice, clove, pepper, vanilla and toasted caramel.
bottles.palate: Fresh, poised red fruit and warming spice, supported by fine silky tannins.
bottles.finish: Persistent, refreshing red-fruit and spice finish.
bottles.pairingBasis: Sommelier suggestions to complement Rioja's oak spice and acidity.
bottles.aeration: A brief 20-minute decant can help; older vintages need gentler handling.
bottles.sourceLabel: La Rioja Alta 2017 official tasting sheet
bottles.vintageNote: The profile follows Viña Ardanza Reserva 2017; other releases and image vintages may vary.

bottles.intro: A fruit-forward Chianti Classico with flowers, red berries and the freshness that makes Tuscan reds so food-friendly.
bottles.nose: Violet, dog rose, lavender, red currant, wild strawberry and raspberry.
bottles.palate: Refined and energetic, with bright red fruit, savory lift and supple lively tannins.
bottles.finish: Fresh, savory and fruit-rich.
bottles.pairingBasis: Sommelier suggestions based on the producer's bright fruit and savory acidity.
bottles.aeration: Optional short aeration, but avoid serving too warm.
bottles.sourceLabel: Marchesi Antinori Pèppoli 2023 tasting notes
bottles.vintageNote: The profile describes the 2023 wine; pictured Pèppoli label may be another year.

bottles.intro: A polished high-altitude Mendoza Malbec blending ripe fruit with floral lift and a soft, lively texture.
bottles.nose: Ripe red and dark fruits, delicate flowers, traces of vanilla, leather and mocha.
bottles.palate: Plush and rich yet bright, with concentrated fruit and a refreshing line of acidity.
bottles.finish: Juicy, persistent fruit with gentle tannins.
bottles.pairingBasis: Sommelier pairing suggestions informed by Catena's dark-fruit and balanced structure.
bottles.aeration: Consider 20–30 minutes of air for a young bottle.
bottles.sourceLabel: Winebow distributor Catena Malbec 2022 tasting sheet
bottles.vintageNote: Notes relate to the 2022 Catena Malbec technical sheet; image vintage may differ.

bottles.intro: A juicy, fruit-forward Gamay from northern Beaujolais with easygoing freshness and surprisingly satisfying texture.
bottles.nose: Ripe strawberries and black cherries with a hint of gentle spice.
bottles.palate: Fresh red berries, bright acidity and a lightly rounded medium-bodied texture.
bottles.finish: Juicy and clean, with a subtle spicy edge.
bottles.pairingBasis: Producer's suggested categories include mild cheese, vegetables and poultry.
bottles.aeration: A light chill brings out the fruit; normally no decanting needed.
bottles.sourceLabel: Louis Jadot importer 2023 release sheet
bottles.vintageNote: Tasting references Beaujolais-Villages 2023; photographed bottle may be a different vintage.

bottles.intro: A lively dry Mosel Riesling with citrus energy and a stony slate character, distinct from the sweeter Blue Slate Kabinett.
bottles.nose: Bright citrus and fresh guava with subtle mineral notes.
bottles.palate: Fresh citrus, brisk acidity and clean mineral definition.
bottles.finish: Crisp and stony, leaving a dry, mouthwatering impression.
bottles.pairingBasis: Sommelier recommendations for the crisp dry style; not the off-dry Kabinett.
bottles.aeration: Serve chilled without decanting.
bottles.sourceLabel: Gismondi On Wine: Dr. Loosen Blue Slate Dry 2019
bottles.vintageNote: This is explicitly the 2019 Blue Slate Riesling Dry, not the similarly named Blue Slate Kabinett. Image should be checked for the dry label.

bottles.region: Alto Adige / upper Adige River Valley
bottles.intro: An Alpine Pinot Grigio with a clear apple-and-citrus profile and a clean, savory finish.
bottles.nose: Golden Delicious apple, delicate citrus and subtle orchard florals.
bottles.palate: Dry, well-balanced apple and citrus fruit, with refreshing acidity and moderate body.
bottles.finish: Clean, lightly savory and layered.
bottles.pairingBasis: Santa Margherita US pairing guidance includes seafood, shellfish, white meats and light pasta.
bottles.aeration: Chill lightly and use a white-wine glass; avoid overcooling.
bottles.sourceLabel: Santa Margherita producer Pinot Grigio and growing-region notes
bottles.vintageNote: The producer sources Pinot Grigio across Alto Adige and Valdadige; the labeled bottling and vineyard blend may differ by market and vintage.

bottles.intro: A textured, oak-influenced South African Chenin Blanc with ripe fruit, honeyed complexity and enough freshness for food.
bottles.nose: Melon and spiced baked apple, with delicate toasty notes.
bottles.palate: Layered honeycomb and caramel over ripe fruit, balanced by mineral tones and subtle vanilla oak.
bottles.finish: Rounded, softly spicy and lingering.
bottles.pairingBasis: Ken Forrester's 2022 sheet lists spicy dishes, full-flavored fish, chicken and prawns.
bottles.aeration: A brief rest in the glass reveals its texture; avoid serving too cold.
bottles.sourceLabel: Ken Forrester Old Vine Reserve Chenin Blanc 2022 technical sheet
bottles.vintageNote: These aromas and pairings specifically describe the 2022 release.

bottles.intro: A refreshing Kamptal Grüner made from terraces, combining ripe orchard fruit, subtle mineral grip and a distinctive peppery finish.
bottles.nose: Ripe apple, citrus, acacia blossom and a lightly yeasty note.
bottles.palate: Dry and vivid, with orchard and stone fruit, gentle herbs and an elegant mineral structure.
bottles.finish: Peppery, mineral and mouthwatering.
bottles.pairingBasis: Producer's 2024 sheet lists fish, seafood, poultry, veal, Asian cuisine and cream cheese.
bottles.aeration: Serve chilled, but let it warm slightly for herbal notes to emerge.
bottles.sourceLabel: Bründlmayer Kamptal Terrassen 2024 official factsheet
bottles.vintageNote: Tasting descriptors and service temperature refer to the 2024 Terrassen bottling.

bottles.intro: An aromatic Alsace Gewürztraminer with exotic fruit, floral perfume and textured spice.
bottles.nose: Lychee, rose, jasmine, ripe peach and apricot.
bottles.palate: Broad texture, fresh acidity, aromatic fruit, ginger and clove.
bottles.finish: Lingering floral warmth and sweet spice.
bottles.pairingBasis: Importer notes recommend aromatic spice; dishes are sommelier suggestions.
bottles.aeration: Chill but allow aromas to develop in the glass.
bottles.sourceLabel: Trimbach 2022 importer technical sheet
bottles.vintageNote: Descriptors refer to the 2022 vintage; sweetness varies by release.

bottles.wine: Whispering Angel Côtes de Provence Rosé
bottles.intro: A pale rosé with red-berry perfume and a smooth yet dry palate.
bottles.nose: Fresh red berries and gentle floral aromas.
bottles.palate: Ripe, rounded red-fruit character that remains bone-dry.
bottles.finish: Smooth and clean without harsh astringency.
bottles.pairingBasis: Château d'Esclans cites Mediterranean, charcuterie and Asian cuisines.
bottles.aeration: Serve chilled; do not decant.
bottles.sourceLabel: Whispering Angel producer description
bottles.vintageNote: House-style description; actual vintage and bottle label may differ.

bottles.intro: A fuller, structured Rhône rosé, unlike many lighter Provence examples.
bottles.nose: Delicate flowers and fruity aromas.
bottles.palate: Fleshy, structured fruit balanced by appealing acidity.
bottles.finish: Harmonious, persistent and refreshing.
bottles.pairingBasis: Guigal lists fish, charcuterie and grilled meat.
bottles.aeration: Serve less cold than pale rosé to appreciate the texture.
bottles.sourceLabel: E. Guigal official Tavel tasting notes
bottles.vintageNote: Producer provides cross-vintage tasting notes; pictured year may vary.

bottles.intro: A crisp Prosecco with orchard fruit, citrus and fine bubbles.
bottles.nose: Fresh apples, pears, Mediterranean citrus and white flowers.
bottles.palate: Energetic fruit with persistent bubbles and cleansing acidity.
bottles.finish: Crisp and refreshing.
bottles.pairingBasis: Producer recommends raw seafood and fried fish.
bottles.aeration: Serve chilled and freshly opened.
bottles.sourceLabel: La Marca Treviso Brut product tasting notes
bottles.vintageNote: This is Treviso Brut rather than the sweeter La Marca flagship Prosecco DOC.

bottles.intro: A lively traditional-method Cava combining fresh orchard fruit and citrus.
bottles.nose: Fresh apple, ripe pear and bright citrus.
bottles.palate: Crisp, clean and balanced, with lively bubbles and apple-pear fruit.
bottles.finish: Refreshingly citrusy with a touch of ginger.
bottles.pairingBasis: Freixenet recommends rich crispy dishes, including fried chicken.
bottles.aeration: Serve chilled without decanting.
bottles.sourceLabel: Freixenet official Cordon Negro Brut notes
bottles.vintageNote: A non-vintage blend; dosage and labels can differ by market.

bottles.intro: A rich reserve Port emphasizing fresh black fruit and a full-bodied structure.
bottles.nose: Blackberry, blackcurrant, liquorice and ripe plum.
bottles.palate: Generous dark fruit with an indulgent texture and good structure.
bottles.finish: Long, concentrated and fruit-forward.
bottles.pairingBasis: Graham's recommends dark chocolate and mature cheeses.
bottles.aeration: Serve slightly chilled; bottled ready to drink.
bottles.sourceLabel: Graham's Six Grapes official tasting notes
bottles.vintageNote: A non-vintage reserve Port; the bottle design may change.
